title: Which focused fixtures demonstrate the portable layout and preservation seams?
question: Which focused fixtures demonstrate the portable layout and preservation seams?
answer:
V3-17: Focused red/green fixtures plus real Genesis and Adoption exercises prove the portable contract; the v2 upgrade path receives its own migration fixture.
V3-17A: Valid and invalid manifests, legacy-path migration, missing-skill install, existing-skill preservation, explicitly authorized update with backup, project-local shadows, conflicting destinations, and portable path handling.
